name: SM_Hero_Sword_Claw_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: grip centre at the origin; +X to the tip; flats of the blade on +Z / -Z (see tools/build_weapons.py)
dresses: claw sword, 0.98 m over all, 0.84 m blade with four hooked claws on one edge above the guard: blue-cast steel, green bronze guard and pommel with garnets, dark red grip
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The four claws are separate hooked blades pushed into the +Y edge, not forged from it. Baked from a procedural source: no maker's marks, engraving or damage from use beyond stains and edge wear. Static (no cloth, tassel or scabbard). The grip transform was derived from the hand bone landmarks and checked in one idle and one attack frame only.

grip.x: towards the tip (upper limb for a bow)
